objective: Make the site explainable and submit updated discovery signals
action: Publish the 48-hour sprint page, verify favicon and sitemap, submit IndexNow after deploy
success_signal: Production health pass, IndexNow 200, new route in sitemap
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Stop adding pages if technical discovery fails
privacy_boundary: No private account screenshots in public files

objective: Create a public technical proof trail
action: Publish README with live site, route method, sample, fit review, and validation limits
success_signal: Repository profile can explain the site without a private chat
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Rewrite if README reads like marketing without useful links
privacy_boundary: No customer data, payment identifiers, or private replies

action: Prepare Product Hunt, Show HN, and directory copy without posting to communities that reject self-promotion
success_signal: At least one compliant draft ready and source rules recorded
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Delay if the product is not usable enough for that platform

action: Prepare 5 answer angles around route selection, first traffic, evidence hierarchy, no-guarantee scoring, and AI service launch validation
success_signal: Questions and answers can solve a decision without forced promotion
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Stop if the answer only points to AgentSiteOps and does not solve the question
privacy_boundary: Follow community rules; no automated posting

action: Send up to 20 manual messages to AI-capable builders using the sample and no-guarantee boundary
success_signal: Qualified replies, sample views, objections, payment clicks, or usable intake
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Stop after 20 targeted prospects with no qualified reply and rewrite offer

objective: Seek peer critique before broader launch
action: Ask builders, SEO operators, and AI workflow sellers to critique route selection and pricing clarity
success_signal: Specific objections, wording fixes, referral offers, or segment recommendations
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Stop if reviewers cannot explain the product after reading sample and method
privacy_boundary: Do not publish names or private comments

objective: Make continue, rewrite, or pivot decision
action: Compare visits, source clicks, sample views, PayPal clicks, qualified replies, confirmed payments, usable intake, and objections
success_signal: A recorded decision: continue, rewrite, narrow, pivot_to_implementation, or stop
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Do not continue just because pages are indexed or viewed
